Brand History: Suburban Studios was rebranded within Choice Hotels’ extended-stay strategy, alongside the introduction of proprietary kitchen-in-a-box solutions to provide an accessible entry point to extended-stay conversions and operations (Choice extended-stay development materials).
Guest Psychographics Description: Cost- and convenience-minded travelers who need residential functionality for weeks-long work, relocation, or personal transitions—aligned with Choice’s broader extended-stay guest profiles.
Key Brand Differentiators:
Rebranded extended-stay offer within Choice’s portfolio with kitchen-in-a-box conversion support.

Shared extended-stay infrastructure with MainStay, WoodSpring, and Everhome.

Focus on length-of-stay economics vs. traditional nightly operations.
Sustainability Positioning: Supports Choice Hotels' Room to be Green® program and published ESG commitments on energy, water, waste, and community impact.

Brand Customer Promise: Well-priced, convenient extended-stay accommodations that are clean, well maintained, and purpose-built for guests who need to stay longer—backed by an award-winning economy extended-stay leader.
Brand Value Proposition:
Guests: Practical lodging with the amenities longer-staying guests expect at the value they want—simplicity, convenience, and professionally managed suites.

Communities: Lodging for work and leisure visitors who support local retail, food and beverage, and events.

Owners: All-new prototypical properties with form, function, and beauty; 70+ category experts supporting properties through the life of the contract.
Brand Pillars:
Extended-stay value — economy extended stay designed for 20+ night stays and transitional life phases.

Award-winning satisfaction — #1 in guest satisfaction among economy extended-stay hotel brands (J.D. Power 2023; see jdpower.com/awards).

Purpose-built prototype — all-new, expertly designed properties setting a new industry benchmark.

Choice scale — part of Choice Hotels with global distribution and operational support.
Brand History: Founded on the idea of inviting guests to stay a little longer, WoodSpring traces its extended-stay roots to Jack DeBoer’s apartment-style living innovation (1975), the launch of ValuePlace (2002), rebranding to WoodSpring Suites (2015), and joining Choice Hotels International (2018). The brand reports 235 properties open with another 225 under development (materials date).
Guest Psychographics Description: Transplants from other cities seeking practical, clean, well-maintained accommodations for longer stays due to work or life circumstances; they appreciate simplicity and convenience and rank WoodSpring highly for satisfaction in the economy extended-stay segment.
Key Brand Differentiators:
Economy extended-stay flagship with J.D. Power guest satisfaction leadership.

Entirely prototypical, purpose-designed hotels with dedicated expert support.

Stay occasions spanning work crews, healthcare, relocation, and residential transitions.

Backed by Choice Hotels infrastructure and nearly 7,500 properties worldwide (corporate materials).
Sustainability Positioning: Supports Choice Hotels' Room to be Green® program and published ESG commitments on energy, water, waste, and community impact.
